subject: Re: Weekend plans
text: Oh, glad you asked! I've actually shaken things up a bit since our last chat. I was going to spend Saturday wandering the market and then meeting that book club group, but honestly the idea feels more tiring than fun now. I think I need quieter downtime before the week starts. So the new plan is to walk the riverside trail early, grab a pastry on the way home, and then putter around the shed for half the afternoon. Sunday might still include that casual board game afternoon, but only if I'm feeling up to it. If not, maybe next time works better. Of course, if the weather turns rough, I'll swap the walk for a long coffee and some sketching. Either way, I'm trying to stop booking myself solid every weekend.
